title: OpenConnect SAML login: embedded web view is fixed at 640x480, identity provider pages are clipped and cannot be reached
line: The OpenConnect single sign-on page now grows when the VPN login dialog is enlarged or maximized, so big identity provider pages are no longer cut off.
explanation: The embedded web view for SAML/SSO logins had a fixed 640x480 size, and the kded password dialog is capped at 640 px wide in its .ui file. Enlarging or maximizing the dialog only added empty space around the view, so identity provider pages bigger than 640x480 stayed clipped (with full-height layouts the Next button could not be reached at all). The view now has 640x480 as its minimum size and takes the dialog's spare height, and the width cap is lifted for OpenConnect dialogs only, so the page grows with the dialog.

commits.message:
openconnect: let the SAML login page grow with the dialog

The single sign-on web view had a fixed 640x480 size and the dialog was
capped at 640 px wide, so bigger identity provider pages stayed clipped.
Make 640x480 the minimum, give it the spare height and drop the cap.

BUG: 528259

media.caption: Pure master, dialog maximized: the view stays 640x480, the page is still clipped
With the fix, dialog maximized: the view fills the dialog and the whole sign-in page shows, logo to footer
With the fix, dialog dragged larger by its corner: the view grows with it and Next becomes visible
Pure master: Connect (first click lost), sign-in page loads clipped, maximize leaves it clipped

review.text: Clean, targeted fix in plasma-nm that replaces the hardcoded 640x480 fixed size on the OpenConnect SAML QWebEngineView with a 640x480 minimum size, gives loginBox vertical stretch so it grows with the dialog, and lifts PasswordDialog's 640 px max-width cap for OpenConnect only. Before/after screenshots and video confirm the full identity provider page becomes reachable when maximizing or resizing while keeping the initial size, View Log behavior, and non-OpenConnect password dialogs intact.

reviews.text: Clean, targeted fix in plasma-nm that replaces the hardcoded 640x480 fixed size on the OpenConnect SAML QWebEngineView with a 640x480 minimum size, gives loginBox vertical stretch so it grows with the dialog, and lifts PasswordDialog's 640 px max-width cap for OpenConnect only. Before/after screenshots and video confirm the full identity provider page becomes reachable when maximizing or resizing while keeping the initial size, View Log behavior, and non-OpenConnect password dialogs intact.

Small, correctly placed fix: the SAML QWebEngineView becomes minimum 640x480 instead of fixed, the login box gets the spare height, and the 640 px width cap from passworddialog.ui is lifted only for OpenConnect, so the reporter's stated expectation ("or the dialog can be resized") is met. The fake Idira-style gateway reproduces the clipped page, and the maximize and drag-resize screenshots show the whole page and the Next button becoming reachable, with View Log, Cancel and the Wi-Fi dialog checked for regressions. Nitpicks: the default size is still 640x480, so the page starts clipped until the user enlarges the dialog, and some spare height still lands under View Log. Neither blocks merging.
